decision: NO_BULL_STRETCH/FIFO/BASE improves target return and DD; PRE still negative, not adoption. Baseline excludes missing old features, target and forward unchanged; reserve and trailing do not improve target absolute return. Independent validation outstanding.

protocol.scope: Same R17 common period, initial10000, gross0.30 per entry, two slots, 12h cooldown, 10/30bps. All source periods previously inspected.
protocol.gate_definition: Completed H1 BTC24/72 both positive veto; 3h asset decline >2 prior ATR veto; BTC3h positive veto. Fixed thresholds from diagnostic, no forward price input.
protocol.reserve: At most one simultaneous OLD24, NEW48 may use two slots, no forced exit, no additional gross.
protocol.trail: Keep original STOP8 and TP8 if NEW, and native H24/H48. Only after completed M5 low indicates >=2% favorable excursion, stop at prior running low*1.015; check open gap then intrabar STOP before target, update running low after bar. No same-bar activation. No funding.
protocol.comparison: 36 fixed arms + same-tape standalones. Record actual route PnL and blocks. No adoption without independent/stress verification.
